# Held, not shippable (offline-only)

These files were retired 2026-10-05 as part of making EXALTED Terminal 77 offline-only and local-only.
They are **HELD, NOT DELETED** — recoverable from git history (commit 2c27df4 and e769732).

- docs/nexus-description.bbcode.txt — Nexus/online-publishing surface (retired)
- scripts/rv1909/reconstruct_digital_es.py — audit-witness tool for RV1909 reconstruction (retired)
